status: Registered before any feature-model fit. Explicitly retrospective; no prospective holdout claimed.
sources: Free official MLB StatsAPI 2024–26 regular-season schedules plus team game logs supplied by sibling collector. No paid calls or historical odds.

baseline.name: Active September14 score-rating formula, same collected history
baseline.interpretation: These settings were selected after2026 outcomes in earlier work. Their later-period performance is a descriptive same-period comparator, not a baseline that was historically frozen in2025.

secondaryBaseline: Original Ridge v1 MLB settings:halfLife120,penalty6,homePrior0.2,homePenalty30,lookback730,no rest. Same eligible source history and cutoffs.

dates.pastInspection: Much ofJune–September2026 was inspected in prior tuning/reviews. Later-date validation is retrospective temporal validation, not a new independent holdout.

eligibility: Regular-season completed non-tied MLB games only. Exclude known suspended/resumed games if exact time of stat availability cannot be established. Require both teams>=10 eligible prior completed games. Report every missing/unmatched/excluded game. Do not exclude games for large errors or absent prices.

chronology.embargo: For a target on UTC dateD, every input result/stat must come from a game with UTC start date<=D−2. This full-day buffer avoids ordinary overnight-completion ambiguity. Known suspension/resumption cases excluded unless availability established. No same-day doubleheader input.
chronology.baselineFit: Daily prequential score-rating refit on the same embargoed historical rows, asOfD, no future team coefficients.
chronology.residualLabels: Each historical target residual equals actual margin minus its own genuinely prequential active prediction, not an in-sample full-history fitted value.
chronology.residualFit: At each Monday UTC block cutoffC, fit only historical labeled rows with target date<=C−2, within730 days, minimum500 eligible labels. During later validation coefficients may refit under the frozen rule using only then-past outcomes; feature family/window/penalty never retuned.
chronology.standardization: Fit feature medians, means and standard deviations from only the same prior residual-training rows. Missing values imputed by those training medians with missingness indicators. Intercept unpenalized; other standardized coefficients ridge-penalized.

common: active prequential predicted margin, allowing a fitted calibration slope correction
runs: home-minus-away rolling runs scored per game
away-minus-home rolling runs allowed per game
boxscore: home-minus-away batting hits,walks,strikeouts,home-runs per plate appearance
away-minus-home pitching hits,walks,strikeouts,home-runs allowed per recorded out
context: home-minus-away pitching staff workload:outs and pitches in prior3 calendar days, under the same embargo
home-minus-away prior7 calendar day game count
prior730-day venue total-run environment relative to league total runs,smoothed by100 venue games,and its interaction with active margin
features.venueLimit: This is an empirical venue run-environment proxy,not an official causal park factor. It uses only past dates; no full-season park factors.
features.bullpenLimit: Use exact historical relief innings/pitches only if collector provides defensible splits. Otherwise staff workload is explicitly a proxy and never called bullpen innings. No costly inferred starter splits.
features.starterPolicy: No target starter/player identity from retroactively fetched final probablePitcher or actual starter fields. No historical pregame snapshots exist here; no target starter feature.
excludedFutureFeatures: pitch locations or strike zones with2026 definition breaks

candidates.total: 21 residual specifications plus the unadjusted active baseline. Calibration-only has no rolling-window duplication.
candidates.selection: Lowest development MAE, thenRMSE,then fewer feature columns,then stable ID. Baseline participates, so no change can win. Freeze selection before scoring later-period outcomes. No post-validation reselection.

metrics.primary: Home-minus-away run margin MAE on common eligible games
metrics.uncertainty: Paired Monday-week block bootstrap of selected-minus-active MAE,5000 draws,seed20260917; exploratory intervals, preserve complete within-week pairs.
metrics.probabilities: No probability calibration model is fit,so no Brier/confidence claims.
metrics.profit: No ATS,units or ROI claims without original historical offers. Better sign accuracy cannot override worse primary MAE.

recommendation: Retain active model unless later MAE improves credibly with no worse RMSE and adequate paired coverage; any useful candidate may be recommended for a separate prospective shadow,not automatically activated. No new arbitrary calendar lock.
integrityChecks: Future/same-day outcome poison must not alter earlier features or predictions
No team stats from target game or same date enter predictors
Runtime score-rating parity against actual Site module
Candidate selection artifact written before later validation metrics are computed
